scope: One additive separate FieldLog workflow; development host only

inputs.sdkManifestFormat: Sorted lowercase SHA-256, two spaces, POSIX path relative to sdk, LF; runtime workflow records its own public checkout manifest

validation.yamlParser: Ruby Psych YAML.load_file; YAML 1.1 on key normalized for validation only

checks.name: Record actual toolchain and source inputs
Run real ReportRoot and ReportFiles JVM checks

validation.historicalAppEvidence: R1784; unchanged application bodies. Recipe evidence R1804. No results inferred for Xcode 26.3.

workflowBehavior.scratchAndCaches: Unique RUNNER_TEMP prefix per run ID and attempt; no HOME or CODEX_HOME override
workflowBehavior.bounds: 15 minute job; preflight 2, Swift 9, JVM 2, recipe 1 minutes; per-log tee file-size ceiling 8192 shell blocks
workflowBehavior.exitStatus: bash set -euo pipefail; real commands and tee exit statuses; no synthetic result parser
workflowBehavior.upload: Only evidence logs and SDK file manifest, always, 14 day retention; no build/cache trees
workflowBehavior.independentControls: Java and recipe execute after Swift failure when input preflight succeeded and job is not cancelled

nextExecutableGate.name: GeneratedReport host development / generated-report-host
nextExecutableGate.action: Publish this one-file patch to separate FieldLog, then inspect the actual path-triggered CI run at the published head; do not start another preparation cycle.
nextExecutableGate.manualDispatchIfNeeded: gh workflow run generated-report-host.yml --repo snowdamiz/fieldlog --ref main
nextExecutableGate.acceptance: Actual Xcode 26.3 tool/version log, Swift XCTest and Swift Testing summaries, JVM RESULT summary, unittest summary and successful real command exits

limitations: Hosted Xcode 26.3 execution is pending; prior local Swift 6.4.2 qualification is historical only.
Development host evidence does not qualify JNI, APK/native/UI/device behavior, immutable published packages, dogfood or GA.
No remote fetch was needed: review used accepted unheld R1804 static inputs and root-delivered R1820 proof. Actual second checkout is exercised by hosted CI.

retention.artifactPolicyCheck: Not run: no staging or index mutation is authorized; root runs policy check if staging this compact receipt.
